'''Gen Vizla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and a member of [[Clan Vizla]], living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. On [[Vaiken Spacedock]] he worked with fellow Mandalorian, [[Braum Bourne]] to help train promising [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Sent their way by [[Rally Master]] [[Merrk Kelborn]] during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]], Gen and Braum helped give tips to the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]], both becoming very impressed with the young bounty hunter.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Before the mission's removal from the game, Gen Vizla appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Advanced Training mission for the Bounty Hunter class, wherein players were sent to him and [[Braum Bourne|Braum "Zakkeg" Bourne]] by [[Rally Master]] [[Merrk Kelborn]] in order to receive advice on whether to learn the skills of either a [[Powertech]] or a [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]]. While Bourne preferred the Powertech specialization, Vizla advocated for the Mercenary specialization. He could be found both on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and in the [[Mandalorian enclave]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. In the German version of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', his last name was spelled "Vizsla," similar to [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Tor Vizsla]].<ref name="TOR" />
